title: First 90d Activation KPI Playlist & Stability Canvas
content:
Purpose:
This doc is a tactical, rolling 90-day activation plan for new product features and platform changes. Focus: ensure predictable metrics, clear owner actions, and an early stability runway (0–90 days). This is a working canvas for Product Ops + PMs + SRE to sync cadence, signal thresholds, and contingency playbooks.

Scope (what this covers):
- Launch window: day 0 (release) through day 90.
- Customer cohorts: internal beta -> staged public -> full ramp.
- Metrics and thresholds for adoption, latency, error budget burn, cost-per-call.
- Operational runbooks and escalation owners for top failure modes.

High-level goals (90d):
1) Validate product-market signals (activation, retained DAU) for early cohorts.
2) Keep platform latency P95 <= 600ms and error rate < 0.5% in steady-state.
3) Ensure cost-per-1000-requests remains within budget band +/- 20%.
4) Create an actionable triage path for any threshold breach.

90-day phased checklist (owners & cadence):
- Phase 0 (pre-release, -14 to -1 days):
  - Owners: PM, Eng Lead, QA, ProdOps (Priya)
  - Tasks: final smoke tests, staging load run, traffic gating plan, customer comms draft.
  - KPI gate: automated smoke pass with no blocking defects; staging P95 <= 800ms.
- Phase 1 (day 0–7): soft rollout to internal beta cohort (~1% traffic)
  - Owners: Release Lead (Evan), SRE on-call (Tom), CS pilot owner (Lina)
  - Tasks: monitor first-response feedback, run daily health digest, freeze non-critical deploys.
  - KPIs: activation rate >= 60% for pilot users; error rate < 1%
- Phase 2 (day 8–30): staged public ramp to 10–25%
  - Owners: PM + ProdOps
  - Tasks: ramp schedule, capacity check, prompt/eval quality spot checks.
  - KPIs: retention at day7 >= target baseline; latency P95 <= 700ms; cost curve trending under forecast.
- Phase 3 (day 31–90): full ramp and optimization
  - Owners: Growth PM, Infra Eng, Optimize PM
  - Tasks: quantization/throughput tuning, batching tweaks, continuous evals, post-launch retro at 45d and 90d.
  - KPIs: day30 retention, cost per 1k tokens, SLOs maintained, feature adoption distribution across cohorts.

KPI catalog (primary signals):
- Activation rate: percent of trial users who complete the activation funnel (target: 55–75% depending on cohort).
- Retention: D1, D7, D30 (targets to be set per feature).
- Latency: P50, P95, P99 (targets: P50 < 150ms, P95 < 600ms, P99 < 1200ms).
- Errors: 4xx/5xx ratios, model/fallback errors (threshold: <0.5% steady).
- Cost metrics: cost-per-1k-requests, GPU-hours per 100k tokens.
- Quality regressions: eval set pass rate (automated tests), human quality spot-check fail rate.

Operability & runbook (fast reference):
- Immediate triggers (auto-alert + Slack #activation-watch):
  - Latency P95 > 900ms for 5+ minutes -> page SRE-1 and throttle new traffic.
  - Error rate > 2% for 3+ minutes -> activate rollback plan and notify PM/CS.
  - Cost spike > 50% vs baseline for 30 minutes -> throttle non-critical routes and open cost-incident channel.
- Triage steps (first 15 minutes):
  1) Check gateway and infra dashboards (RBAC views: infra/latency, app/errors).
  2) Confirm scope (all regions? single model? specific route?).
  3) If model related, switch to fallback model variant (pre-approved) and note token delta.
  4) If infra related, scale up capacity (if bursting allowed) or reroute to another region.
  5) If unknown, rollback to last stable release and capture dump for post-mortem.
- Communication protocol:
  - Incident owner posts initial note in #activation-watch with summary + ETA within 10 minutes.
  - Product Ops updates stakeholders via daily incident digest until resolved.

Go/no-go and escalation matrix (decision rules):
- Hard no-go: any security vulnerability exploit discovered; data leakage confirmed; critical privacy violation.
- Soft no-go (delay ramp): staging tests fail, P95 > 1s sustained, or human-quality fail rate > 10% on control prompts.
- Escalation owners by severity:
  - Sev1 (customer-facing outage): SRE lead -> CTO; executive brief within 60 minutes.
  - Sev2 (degraded but functioning): Eng Manager -> PM -> daily check-ins.

Traffic shaping & capacity knobs:
- Ramp plan template: 1% -> 5% -> 10% -> 25% -> 50% -> 100% (each step min 24–72 hours monitoring).
- Autoscale rules: prefer vertical for short spikes; pre-warm GPU pools before >25% ramp.
- Fallback models: list pre-compiled model variants with expected latency/cost delta and quality delta (attach eval link).

Risk register (top 6):
1) Model quality regression on edge prompts -> mitigations: prompt list whitebox, A/B testing with control prompts.
2) Unexpected traffic surge -> mitigations: circuit breakers, burst pool.
3) Cost runaway from unbounded caching -> mitigations: caching TTL caps, monitoring alerts.
4) Multi-region inconsistency -> mitigations: gradual region ramp, cross-region smoke tests.
5) Customer support load spikes -> mitigations: canned responses, CS runbook, priority support queue.
6) Compliance gating (enterprise customers) -> mitigations: private deployment checklist and sales signoff.

Data & dashboards (where to look):
- Primary dashboard: Product Ops activation board (link: CONFLUENCE:prodops/activation-dashboard).
- Infra dashboards: latency/error/cost views in Datadog and internal Redwood Console per-route panels.
- Quality monitoring: continuous-evals dashboard with prompt set snapshot.

Post-launch cadence & artifacts:
- Daily: 7am activation digest (owner: Priya) with top 5 signals and any trending anomalies.
- Weekly (first 4 weeks): 30-minute sync with PM/Eng/SRE/CS to resolve open items.
- 45-day review: operational health + adoption deep-dive, decide next optimization batch.
- 90-day readout: acceptance or deprecation decision, formal retro, ledger of changes and follow-ups.

Open TODOs (next 10 days):
- Finalize cohort sizes for each ramp step (owner: PM, due 2025-01-20).
- Add concrete target numbers for D1/D7/D30 retention per persona (owner: Growth, due 2025-01-22).
- Publish pre-approved fallback model list with eval deltas (owner: Applied ML, due 2025-01-24).
- Create an automated alert for cost-per-1k with 3-tier thresholds (owner: Observability, due 2025-01-28).

Notes to self (working):
- Keep this doc lean — move orchestration details to runbook repo; keep signals and owner ladder here.
- Expect iterations after first beta cohort; we should avoid rigid gates on quality until we have n>=1000 users in a cohort.

Appendix (short):
- Contact list: Priya Nair (prodops), Evan Chen (release), Tom Brooks (sre), Lina Morales (cs), Dr. Amit Shah (applied-ml).
- Quick links: CONFLUENCE:prodops/activation-template | JIRA:PRODOPS-482 | GITHUB:repo/infra#214.
